title: PNP revokes firearms licenses of vlogger who fired gun at Pampanga fish pond
summary: The Philippine National Police (PNP) has revoked all seven firearms licenses of a vlogger who was caught on video indiscriminately firing a gun at a fish pond in Pampanga.
